meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散素材剪成品牌片、混剪或多场景长视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把手头素材剪成完整视频却找不到合适模板
copy.tagline_en: Cut brand reels, montages, and multi-scene videos from raw footage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn raw clips into a finished video without a ready template

howto.what: 当没有专门的视频工作流匹配时,Claude 用它编写或编辑自定义 HyperFrames 合成:能处理多场景长片、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。开头会先检查技能是否为最新版本。
howto.when: 当没有专门的工作流适用于你要做的视频,或 BRIEF.md 中 flow 设为 companion 时触发;全新创作会先转到 hyperframes,短片无旁白动效则用 motion-graphics。

howto.what_en: When no specialized workflow fits, Claude authors or edits a custom HyperFrames composition: longer multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It first checks the skill is current.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow applies, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh creation routes through hyperframes first; short unnarrated motion units use motion-graphics.
